summary: Ares Industrial Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to report an update of its net asset value and portfolio. This is a routine periodic NAV disclosure by a non-traded REIT, not a corporate action. The filing details the September 30, 2026 NAV per share by class, applied to the November 1, 2026 transaction price, with the board of directors and a majority of independent directors approving the valuation procedures and the engagement of Altus Group U.S. Inc. as independent valuation advisor.
